## Contracts and repository boundaries

- [ ] Configuration, feature/model identity and training-fold isolation remain explicit.
- [ ] Local validation scripts stay in `_verify/`; no credentials, private inputs, research YAMLs or generated outputs are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed; maintainers handle private project-document changes in its separate repository.
- [ ] Changes are staged by explicit paths and the staged diff has been reviewed.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). External contributors do not need access to the private documentation repository.
